Find somewhere warm and easy. I can make it happen.|Cassian Andor, to Maarva Andor|audio=GetOutOfTheColdAndDamp-Announcement.flac|}} '''Niamos''' was a [[Planet|world]] in the [[Vorzyd sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] dominated by [[Water|oceans]] and [[beach]]es. Initially a place for those lying low to gravitate to, it soon fell under the [[Occupation of Niamos|occupation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which laid down new laws. The fugitive [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] traveled there in [[5 BBY]], posing as the tourist "Keef Girgo," but soon found himself in trouble when he was falsely accused and arrested by Imperials and processed at the [[Niamos Courthouse]]. Andor was sentenced to six [[Standard year|years]] of [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|imprisonment]] [[Narkina 5|offworld]] but eventually [[Narkina 5 prison escape|escaped]] with [[Prisoner|inmate]] [[Ruescott Melshi]] and returned to Niamos to retrieve valuables he had left behind. After making a call to the planet [[Ferrix]], Andor parted ways with Melshi. ==Description== {{Quote|You look like you're sweating.''"
"''Well, it's hot.|A shoretrooper confronts Cassian Andor|audio=YouLookLikeYoureSweating-Announcement.flac|}} [[File:Niamos-CLNE.png|thumb|left|300px|Niamos was located in the Outer Rim Territories.]] Niamos was a terrestrial [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' located in the [[Vorzyd sector]]'s [[Niamos system]] within the intersection of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and [[the Slice]] region. Situated at the coordinates R-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it lay along the [[Salin Corridor]] [[hyperspace route]] between the''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' planet{{Databank|veelo|Veelo}} [[Veelo]] and the [[Columex system]], the latter being a junction with the [[Perlemian Trade Route]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] [[super-hyperroute]].{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}} Niamos had a Type I [[atmosphere]], breathable to [[human]]s and various [[alien]] [[species]]. A resort world{{Databank|cassian-andor|Cassian Andor}} decorated with [[ocean]]s and [[beach]]es,{{Databank|niamos|Niamos}} the planet hosted a [[Temperature|warm]] climate, with [[palm tree]]s growing on the surface and fauna including [[bird]]s. The [[Music|song]] "[[Niamos!]]," an intergalactic hit{{Databank|speaker-droid|speaker droid}} by [[4 BBY]],{{Andor|One Year Later}} and [[Niamos Mix]], a [[Foodstuff|food]] served on the planet [[Batuu]]{{GEAttr|Kat Saka's Kettle}} in [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] to [[34 ABY]]. shared their names with the planet. ==History== ===Earlier visits=== {{Quote|Ugghh! ''Aurra Sing!'' Guess you're still angry over that job on ''Niamos."
"''Oh, did you abandon a partner in the middle of a job on Niamos? Forgot about ''that."
"''Good. Not ''healthy'' to carry a grudge.|Jango Fett and Aurra Sing|[[Jango Fett 3|''Jango Fett'' 3]]}} Sometime no later than [[33 BBY]],The events of [[Jango Fett 3|''Jango Fett'' 3]] took place around [[33 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:JangoFettSeriesDate|here]]. the [[bounty hunter]]s [[Jango Fett]] and [[Aurra Sing]] did a [[job on Niamos]]. In the middle of the job, Fett abandoned the other [[Hunting|hunter]], an act neither of them forgot about. Around 33 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], Sing crossed paths with Fett on the [[mining]] planet [[Roxuli]]. As the pair initially fought, they remarked about a grudge being left after Niamos, and Fett later implied that Sing's selfish interests were the reason he ditched her. During his leisure tours, a young [[Jaylen Vrax|Jaylen Barsha]], the [[Reproduction|son]] of the [[Nnytyl Barsha|head]] of the [[Barsha Corporation]], visited the beaches of Niamos for some carefree adventures. He made friends and [[Alcohol|drank]] [[cocktail]]s on the planet, enjoying some of the chaos he experienced there. Vrax would later think back to such times on multiple occasions.''[[Star Wars Outlaws: Low Red Moon]]'' ===Attempted tourism=== {{Quote|I'm just going to the store. It's right there.''"
"''You need to calm down, sir. Droid assistance please.|Cassian Andor is arrested by the Empire|audio=ImJustGoingToTheStore-Announcement.flac|}} By the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Niamos was a hotbed for tourists as well as felons who needed to avoid attention and authorities. However, it was later [[Occupation of Niamos|occupied]] by the Empire, which brought new laws to the world. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|107}} the fugitive [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] traveled to Niamos to lie low after having been involved in a major [[Aldhani heist|heist]] on the planet [[Aldhani]].''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' Intent on outrunning his past and bad decisions for a relaxing life,{{InsiderCite|231|Launchpad}} he posed as the tourist "Keef Girgo" and stayed in a large, airy [[Niamos Hotel|hotel]] suite with a [[Gender|woman]]{{Andor|Announcement}} {{AD|Disney+}} named [[Windi]]. One [[Standard day|day]], Andor was checking a box of valuables he was hiding above the suite's shower, intending on going for a walk afterward. When he let Windi know upon her waking up, she asked him to stop by the beachfront store [[Arkie's]] for several items. [[File:Pier_Nine.png|thumb|right|300px|Cassian Andor is confronted by a shoretrooper near Arkie's.]] Andor made his way along the beachfront to Arkie's when a group of people running from [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|Imperial shoretroopers]] darted past him, prompting him to nervously rush aside from the area. The fugitive then approached Arkie's at [[Pier Nine]] when a [[Unidentified coastal defender stormtrooper (Niamos)|shoretrooper]] noticed him looking aroud. The [[trooper]] began questioning him, falsely accusing him of being one of the runners and flexing his authority{{SW|url=news/andor-episode-7-announcement-highlights|text=''Andor'' Analyzed: 5 Highlights from Episode 7, "Announcement"}} over the supposed tourist. Andor was subsequently grabbed by a [[Unidentified KX-series security droid (Niamos)|KX-series security droid]] and arrested. ===Imperial injustice=== {{Quote|I… I'm sorry, there's something wrong.''"
"''I wouldn't. You've got enough trouble without a Resisting Judgement charge.''"
"''I'm just a tourist.''"
"''Oh, apologies all around then. This used to be a six-month sentence. Six years.|Cassian Andor argues with the Imperial judge|audio=EnoughTroubleWithoutAResistingJudgementCharge-Annoucement.flac|}} [[File:CassianSentenced-Announcement.png|thumb|left|300px|Cassian Andor is sentenced at the Niamos Courthouse.]] At the [[Niamos Courthouse]], Andor joined a queue of sentencings under a [[Unidentified judge|judge]] and [[Unidentified prosecutor|prosecutor]]. When called up, "Girgo" was given several exaggerated charges,{{SW|url=andor-s1-e7-story-gallery|text="Announcement" Story Gallery | Andor}} which he attempted to protest to. However, he was sentenced with six [[Standard year|years]] in [[prison]], an increased sentence due to the Empire's recent [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]] that had come as a response to the Aldhani heist. Andor and the other sentenced individuals were then taken away and [[transport]]ed to different Imperial penal facilities. Andor went on a transport taking convicts to the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison complex]] on{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]], while another transport took convicts to the astronomical object[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] [[Belsavis]]. Eventually, Andor [[Narkina 5 prison escape|escaped]] from the Narkina 5 prison complex, along with the [[Prisoner|inmate]] [[Ruescott Melshi]], and managed to get a ride to Niamos with a couple [[fisher]]s. Andor recovered his box of valuables at the hotel suite, which had become occupied by an alien couple. He made a call to his friend [[Xanwan]] on his adopted [[homeworld]] of [[Ferrix]] to send a message across to his adoptive [[Parent|mother]], [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]]. Xanwan, however, informed Andor that his mother had recently [[Death|died]]. The call ended thereafter, and "Girgo" spoke with Melshi, who parted with him to spread the message about the prison they were in. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], the bounty hunter [[Vail Tormin]] maintained a fortune on Niamos.''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' In [[3 ABY]],{{OutlawsDate}} [[Sliro Barsha]], the [[director]] of the ISB who was fronting a criminal syndicate known as [[Zerek Besh]], hired Tormin to track down the thief [[Kay Vess]]. When Tormin was unsuccessful and wanted out of the contract, Barsha threatened her fortune on Niamos to keep her working for him. ==Inhabitants== {{Quote|Pier Nine, Pier Nine, runners heading south!''"
"''I can wait for you here, if you want.''"
"''Friends of yours?|A shoretrooper, and Cassian Andor|audio=PierNinePierNine-Announcement.flac|}} Niamos was inhabited by numerous humans and individuals of other species, such as [[Blutopian]]s, [[Lacertilo]]s, and another [[Faiza's species|alien species]], notably those who wanted to lay low from authorities. [[Seabird]]s dwelled on the world as well. The [[fathier]] [[jockey]] [[Sanna Kale]] was native to Niamos and rode in the [[Canto Cup]], a [[Fathier racing|fathier race]] on the planet [[Cantonica]] that took place in 3 ABY.{{OutlawsDate}} ==Locations== [[File:Niamos-beachfront-DB.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A beachfront on Niamos]] {{Quote|I'm gonna take a walk.''"
"''Well, we need stuff. Arkie's up the beach. He'll be open.''"
"''I was planning to go the other way.''"
"''Mmm, Arkie has the new flavors.|Cassian Andor and Windi|audio=ArkiesUpTheBeach-Announcement.flac|}} Niamos had seafronts with shallow stairs along them for seating as well as piers. Just up from the beach were walkways, lines of palm [[tree]]s, and large buildings, such as hotels and stores, one of which was Arkie's. During the Empire's occupation, there was a large courthouse where sentences were delivered to dissidents and a landing pad to take convicts offworld on transports. ==Behind the scenes== ===Debut=== {{Quote|Finally! We can unveil that, in the #StarWars universe, Cleveleys is NIAMOS. Episode 7 of #Andor has landed and you can see Cleveleys in all it's glory!|Cleveleys News, on Twitter|{{Twitter|username=cleveleysnews|url=status/1582667889823592448|name=Cleveleys News|date=2022-10-19|quote=Finally! We can unveil that, in the #StarWars universe, Cleveleys is NIAMOS. Episode 7 of #Andor has landed and you can see Cleveleys in all it's glory!|archivedate=20221118002525}}}} Niamos first appeared in "[[Announcement]]," the seventh episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of [[Tony Gilroy]]'s live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''. Directed by [[Benjamin Caron]], the episode premiered on [[October 19]], [[2022]].{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} The location was initially teased in a special look for the series on Disney+''[[Andor: A Disney+ Day Special Look]]'' on [[September 8]] of that year.{{SW|url=news/disney-plus-day-is-here-2022|text=Disney+ Day: New ''Andor'' Special Look Revealed and More!}} ===Filming=== {{Quote|It was actually the first thing I shot on Andor. I said to Diego at some point, 'Can you hear what I'm saying, because my lips feel like they don't work.' But it was great.|Duncan Pow recalls filming his Niamos scene|{{SW|url=news/6-things-we-learned-andor-season-1-with-tony-gilroy-live-stream|text=6 Things We Learned from the ''Andor'' Live Stream with Tony Gilroy}}}} The filming locations for Niamos included two locations in [[Wikipedia:England|England]]. The beach and promenade were shot at the North Promenade of [[Wikipedia:Cleveleys|Cleveleys]] on the [[Wikipedia:The Fylde|Fylde coast]], with the local Café Cove posing as Arkie's. The courthouse was filmed at [[Wikipedia:Carmel College, Oxfordshire|Carmel College]], a closed college in [[Wikipedia:Wallingford, Oxfordshire|Wallingford]], [[Wikipedia:Oxfordshire|Oxfordshire]]. The indoor scenes there were shot in the Grade II listed buildings known as the Boathouse and the Julius Gottlieb Memorial building. The starship courtyard in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]" was filmed at an open-air amphitheater.{{InsiderCite|219|Galactic Britain II: Cassian's Travels}} [[File:CleveleysBrassMarker.jpg|thumb|250px|right|A brass marker installed by Wyre Council to mark the filming location.]] Cleveleys was scouted for ''Andor''{{'s}} production after Location Manager{{WebCite|url=https://www.visitcleveleys.co.uk/about/seafront/star-wars-filming-in-cleveleys|text=End Result of Star Wars Filming in Cleveleys|work=[https://www.visitcleveleys.co.uk Visit Cleveleys]|archivedate=20230919115808}} [[Jason Allen]], who was in fact local to the area, pointed the location scout to the town. Production there took place between [[April 28]] and [[May 11]], [[2021]], with residents in the vicinity receiving letters around mid-[[April]] about closures taking place and subsequent notices being put up around the area. Setup began on [[April 30]], and it reportedly attracted a lot of attention. Locals first started noticing filming on [[May 5]], with a camera-equipped helicopter being used to take the aerial shot of Niamos. The purposes of the film were undisclosed to anyone who saw it, but various observers were able to deduce that it was for ''[[Star Wars]]'' by the time the set was finished, and crowds gathering near the shoots were told to keep quiet during filming. Photos and footage of the filming were posted online during that time. Filming continued through [[May 6]] before the production crew finished and quickly left. The scene on Niamos where Andor and Melshi part ways was set up by Caron and cinematographer [[Damián García]] to be a visual callback to the sunset beach scene at the end of the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which Gilroy had a part in making.''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' That scene was Melshi actor [[Duncan Pow]]'s first filming for the show, and he later recalled how he found it really cold when filming on set. Production staff reportedly had a good experience with the locals and thank you letters were sent to the residents after the filming was finished. The [[Wikipedia:Borough of Wyre|Wyre Council]], which included Cleveleys, hoped to use the area's ''Star Wars'' connections in its wider project to encourage tourism,{{WebCite|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20wrrwkwqvo|text=Promenade plaque marks town's Star Wars connection|date=2024-06-17|work=[[Wikipedia:BBC|BBC]]|archivedate=20250711090458}} and a mural was made at Cleveleys' bus station in [[2024]] that included references to ''Andor''.{{WebCite|url=http://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-lancashire-68775428|text=Cleveleys bus station mural salutes town's place in Star Wars universe|author=Paul Burnell|date=2024-04-14|work=[[Wikipedia:BBC|BBC]]|archivedate=20250527220230}} The project also involved a plaque at the spot where Andor was arrested by the Empire, which was revealed on [[June 16]], [[2025]], to commemorate Cleveley's role in the show.{{WebCite|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c14lzx70zr8o|text=Star Wars beach part of filming impact research|author=Erin Ivey|date=2024-10-23|work=[[Wikipedia:BBC|BBC]]|archivedate=20241213163944}} ===Galactic hit=== {{Quote|When we got to Niamos, it was very, very clear that that was where this track belonged. There's that aerial, flying-over shot, and I said to Tony, "There's only one thing that can go here." We're here, party planet! We call that the "Galaxy Mix." It's actually the intergalactic version.|Nicholas Brittell|{{WebCite|url=https://www.vulture.com/article/nicholas-britell-andor-score-interview.html|text=Nicholas Britell Made ''Andor'' Sound Nothing Like ''Star Wars''|author=Hadidi, Roxana|date=2022-11-24|work=[[Wikipedia:Vulture (website)|''Vulture'']]|archivedate=20250406015712}}}} [[File:LeisureZoneBrothel-Andor.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The song "Niamos!" was originally made for a scene in ''Andor''{{'s}} first episode (pictured).]] In "Announcement," the scenes of Niamos featured the eponymous song "Niamos!," which was scored by composer [[Nicholas Britell]].{{OST|Andor: Vol. 2 (Episodes 5-8) (Original Score)}} It took three forms in season one, "Niamos! (Morlana Club Mix),"{{OST|Andor: Vol. 1 (Episodes 1-4) (Original Score)}} "Niamos! (Coruscant Lounge Mix)," and "Niamos! (Galaxy Mix)." The Morlana Club Mix version was the first piece worked on{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2022/artisans/news/andor-composer-nicholas-britell-score-star-wars-1235383443|text=‘Andor' Composer Nicholas Britell Breaks Down His Score and Why He Incorporated Rustling Leaves|author=Burlingame, Jon|date=2022-09-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20250304113810}} and featured in the season's debut episode "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]],"{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} which aired on [[September 21]], 2022.{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} Britell created the piece to last for an extended period of time and subsequently suggested to Gilroy that the track could recur in various contexts as an "intergalactic hit." Thus, the other two mixes were made, and Galaxy Mix was used for the Niamos scenes. Britell felt it was an obvious fit when first viewing the aerial shot introducing viewers to Niamos's tropical locale without music. The track was remixed by composer [[Brandon Roberts]] for [[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' Season 2]] under the name "Brasso,"{{OST|Andor: Season 2 - Vol. 1 (Episodes 1-3) (Original Score)}} appearing in the third episode, "[[Harvest]],"{{Andor|Harvest}} on [[April 22]], 2025.{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} An extended version of the remix was released by Roberts and Britell on Spotify under "NIAMOS! (Chandrilan Club Mix)."{{Spotify|url=album/6KJMLlCBWkB1gSq0cSYnjd?si=XiKVJ1rUTJGEiK2F2R6Ghg|text=NIAMOS! (Chandrilan Club Mix) - [From "Andor (Season 2)"]}} ===Non-canon stories=== {{Quote|A beach planet?!''"
"''Yeah, isn't it great?|Darth Vader and Emperor Palpatine|{{CelebrateTheSeason|Vader's Vacation}}}} [[File:BummerVacation.png|thumb|right|300px|Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader on holiday on Niamos, with R2-D2 undercover beside them.]] Niamos appeared in "[[Vader's Vacation]]," a [[LEGO]] animated short that is part of the ''[[LEGO STAR WARS: Celebrate the Season]]'' series, which was released on the [[StarWarsKids.com|Star Wars Kids]] YouTube channel on [[July 11]], [[2023]]. In the short, [[canon]]ically set between 3 ABY and [[4 ABY]],"[[Vader's Vacation]]" takes place between the [[Battle of Hoth]] and the [[Battle of Endor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]] respectively. [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] takes his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] for a booked private trip to the planet. Vader was immediately repulsed by the beach planet due to his dislike for sand and continued to be distracted by his decryption of a stolen [[datacard]] with the locations of every Rebel Alliance base. However, he eventually stopped decrypting and joined Palpatine in various beach activities, with different Imperial troopers on vacation around them, too. Meanwhile, the rebel [[droid]] [[R2-D2]] had been sent by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to [[Operation: Bummer Vacation|recover]] the datacard and proceeded to follow Palpatine and Vader around the beach. R2-D2 eventually stole it out of Vader's pocket that evening while he sat on the beach, voicing his satisfaction to Palpatine. The droid then reprogrammed the flight path of Vader and Palpatine's ship to take them to the ice planet [[Hoth]]. Organa congratulated R2-D2 over [[hologram]], telling him he earned a vacation for his success. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Niamos}} *[[Jango Fett 3|''Jango Fett'' 3]] {{Mo}}
